name: Naaman's wife's servant girl
title: The Little Witness
summary: A young Israelite girl who was taken captive by the Arameans and served in the house of the Syrian commander Naaman. Despite her young age and status as a slave, she showed great faith by testifying about the prophet Elisha, which led to Naaman's healing from leprosy.

keyEvents.title: Taken captive from Israel
keyEvents.description: The young girl was kidnapped from Israel during a raid by Aramean troops and was set to serve Naaman's wife.

keyEvents.title: Testifying about the prophet Elisha
keyEvents.description: With bold faith, the servant girl told her mistress that the prophet in Samaria could heal Naaman of his leprosy.

keyEvents.title: Her words reach the king of Aram
keyEvents.description: The girl's testimony was taken seriously and led to Naaman traveling to Israel to seek healing, which resulted in his miraculous recovery.
